{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Hutchinson Utilities Commission Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://newulmmn.gov/330/Natural-Gas|title=newulmmn.gov|website=newulmmn.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Trimont, Minnesota to Hutchinson, Minnesota.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.industrialinfo.com/news/article/hutchinson-utilities-commission-nearing-construction-on-a-new-natural-gas-pipeline--15341|title=industrialinfo.com|website=industrialinfo.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==

=== Trimont to Hutchinson ===
*'''Owner: '''Hutchinson Utilities Commission<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.industrialinfo.com/news/article/hutchinson-utilities-commission-nearing-construction-on-a-new-natural-gas-pipeline--15341|title=industrialinfo.com|website=industrialinfo.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mn.gov/puc-stat/documents//puc_pdf_orders/007383.pdf|title=mn.gov|website=mn.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''89 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.industrialinfo.com/news/article/hutchinson-utilities-commission-nearing-construction-on-a-new-natural-gas-pipeline--15341|title=industrialinfo.com|website=industrialinfo.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://law.justia.com/cases/minnesota/court-of-appeals/2003/op030099-0923.html|title=law.justia.com|website=law.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''16, 12 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.industrialinfo.com/news/article/hutchinson-utilities-commission-nearing-construction-on-a-new-natural-gas-pipeline--15341|title=industrialinfo.com|website=industrialinfo.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://newulmmn.gov/330/Natural-Gas|title=newulmmn.gov|website=newulmmn.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Construction year: '''2003<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.industrialinfo.com/news/article/hutchinson-utilities-commission-nearing-construction-on-a-new-natural-gas-pipeline--15341|title=industrialinfo.com|website=industrialinfo.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$26,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://law.justia.com/cases/minnesota/court-of-appeals/2003/op030099-0923.html|title=law.justia.com|website=law.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
